fixture: vacuous-1.1.0 (paired against conforming-1.1.0, which does not carry it)
note: An empty api_index and an empty patterns array are schema-valid and describe nothing. Both checks quantify over the list, so an empty one satisfies every clause vacuously - the defect the vacuous-conformance round named. It also trips 030, 043 and 044, and that is not incidental: an empty api_index is indistinguishable from removing every public symbol, so a linter reading metadata is RIGHT to report a silent removal. The golden claimed 007 and 008 only, which would have made three correct findings look like false positives.

must_report_on.evidence_note: Evidence is keyed PER CHECK. A finding satisfies this golden only if it names the check AND points at one of that check's own locations - pooling evidence across a case let any check pass on another's, which a shotgun exploited. Where a check's declared violation_unit is the document itself, the document-only form is accepted, per lint-report-v1's evidence description.

must_not_report_on.note: The control ships the same source and conforming metadata. A linter that reports here is reporting on the package, not on the defect.

why_this_case_was_missing: The class was found by reading, then fixed in the checklist, and never given an artifact that demonstrates it.
